nom: Neutrogena Ultra Gentle Daily Face Moisturizer

avis.titre: Like a weighted blanket for my face.
avis.texte: Like a weighted blanket for my face. Listen, my skin is more dramatic than a contestant on a reality dating show. If I so much as look at a scented candle, my face turns into a topographical map of a volcano. I’ve tried moisturizers that claimed to be "gentle" but felt like applying spicy habanero juice mixed with regret. Then came this Neutrogena bottle. Why it’s the GOAT: Total Silence: You know how some "fragrance-free" products still smell like a wet cardboard box or a doctor’s waiting room? This smells like... absolutely nothing. It’s the introverted moisturizer of my dreams. The Texture: It’s lightweight. Usually, "sensitive skin" creams are so thick you need a putty knife to spread them. This sinks in faster than my motivation to go to the gym on a Monday. The "No Sting" Guarantee: I applied this after a chemical peel that left me looking like a glazed ham. Zero stinging. Just pure, unadulterated hydration. It calmed my face down like a hostage negotiator. The Verdict: If your skin treats every external substance like a personal insult, you need this. My face and neck are finally living in peace. We’ve achieved a ceasefire. I no longer look like I’ve just finished a 12-round boxing match with a pollen cloud. Pros: No scent, no grease, no drama. Cons: It’s so good I’m worried it’ll leave me for someone with better bone structure.

This is a nice, lightweight daily moisturizer for daily use. No fragrance, which makes it even gentler on your skin. My tween daughter with sensitive skin loves it. My granddaughter who is also a tween with eczema which is moderate to severe also really loves it!! This product absorbs super easily and leaves no greasy, heavy feel. This product is from a great brand, Neutrogena, with a great amount of product for the price!

I have sensitive skin, so trying new moisturizers has always been hit or miss for me. This is really great though! Think of the texture going on your skin like a lotion with a hint of oil, but in a good way. It absorbs into your skin very well, leaving no oily residue behind. There's really no fragrance, but if I'm just missing it, it's very subtle. It only takes a small amount to get the job done, so don't overuse it. Will be buying again!

I love this moisturizer. It feels clean on my face, not sticky. No scent. Great for my rosacea. BUT! Item was defective. The little foil piece that covers the nozzle would not come off using to scissors and a knife. The knife, however DID puncture the foil, go through and picture the tube, thereby cutting my finger. Trying to deal with Amazon is ridiculous, so I decided to write this review instead.

This moisturizer is absolutely wonderful\! It has a smooth, lightweight texture that absorbs quickly without leaving my skin greasy or sticky\. It leaves my skin feeling soft, hydrated, and refreshed throughout the day\. I also love how gentle it is and how healthy and radiant my skin looks after using it\. I would definitely recommend this moisturizer\!

avis.titre: Nice soft skin with daily use
avis.texte: Love it, not greasy, melts into your skin,no skin irritation, feels good
This is the only moisturizer that doesn’t break my sensitive skin out & its affordable!
I bought this moisturizer for my teen and I love that it doesn't have a fragrance and it has really helped his skin, it tends to be on the dry side. No irritation at all a little pricey but worth it.
This moisturizer is amazing. It’s very lightweight and doesn’t irritate my skin at all. It leaves my face feeling soft and hydrated throughout the day. Definitely a must-have for daily use!

avis.titre: Fortalece la barra de la piel
avis.texte: 💖 Primera impresión: Muy buena elección para complementar la hidratación. 🌸 Lo que me gusta: Niacinamida + ingredientes calmantes suelen funcionar bien para fortalecer la barrera de la piel. ✨ ¿Lo recomendaría? Sí, especialmente para piel sensible. ⭐ Calificación: 8.7/10

avis.titre: No greasy, hot, heavy feel like other brands.
avis.texte: I typically can’t stand lotion on my face but it gets so dry in the winter I have to break down and use some. This stuff is not like typical moisturizers that I’ve tried. It’s so light and not greasy at all. It doesn’t make my face super hot and weird feeling like other ones. I’ll be using this one exclusively from now on! Lasts a long time too. I was expecting a smaller tube.

avis.titre: It’s become a staple in my daily routine!
avis.texte: I’m absolutely loving this moisturizer! It’s super gentle on my sensitive skin, provides just the right amount of hydration, and I love that it’s truly fragrance-free.
Esta crema en realidad es muy buena, hidrata muy bien y es hipoalergénica. La recomiendo.

Estoy en Ecuador, mis productos siempre son Neutrogena por su excelente calidad, porque no tienen fragancia y si veo resultados por eso le doy 5 estrellas. Compré este producto por Internet como todos los otros. No viene en caja, y no tiene en la boquilla del embase una protección adecuada. Tengo un poco de recelo de que el producto haya sido contaminado o manipulado. No puedo devolverlo por cuestiones de distancia y logística. (América del Sur). Supongo que cuando lo pruebe volveré a poner una nueva reseña.

Ive been buying this moisturizer for several months and really liked it as it feels light, doesnt irritate my skin, and absorbs fast. The last bottle I got said "new look" on the top- I didnt think anything of it. After a couple of days my skin is breaking out more and more. I checked the label and sure enough- two new ingredients as compared to the bottle I got before this one! Butylene Glycol and Cantella Asiatica Extract. After checking online, it says that Cantella Asiatica "can cause acne". Thanks Neutrogena for telling us your bottle has a new look but not that you changed the formula!!

This is not for dry / sensitive excema skin, this stings / burns and turns my face red so much, smh it was a good tester subject tho, i used it about 10 minutes after i had shower, i did use the nitrogena oil free acne wash, i did decide to also use the netrogena pink exfoliator once of the week aswell right before but im not sure what my skin type is always get everything sensitive

avis.titre: Quick Absorbing and Leaves Skin Feeling Fresh
avis.texte: I absolutely love the Neutrogena Fragrance-Free Daily Facial Moisturizer! It’s perfect for my combination skin. It doesn’t leave a greasy feeling at all, and it absorbs really quickly, which I really appreciate. Even though my skin is a bit oily in some areas, this moisturizer keeps it feeling fresh and hydrated without being heavy or sticky. It’s definitely a go-to moisturizer that I’ll keep using!
thick consistency. helps with dryness and wrinkles. very sticky. fast absorption.

avis.titre: Ok, I'd like to know why they changed it.
avis.texte: So I just got the "New" formula and I can feel a difference. It used to go on a little thick and creamy, but i could feel it soft on my face the next morning. Now the new one goes dry in about 2 minutes with no exaggerating here. It's also not nearly as soft and almost has a drying effect. I got no notice that I was getting an updated one and will gladly be sending this back. The original was great, but this feel cheap and worthless. I'm really let down.
It came not sealed, but it feels like a full tube. I don’t get it why things are not sealed anymore. That should be in the description; deceiving for sure.
Received as a lose article (not in a box or plastic or anything) and unsealed. I don’t really feel comfortable using this..
We received the item damaged. The tube containing the moisturizer has been compromised, resulting in leakage and spillage of the product.

I’ve used the product in the picture on the left for YEARS. It is now discontinued. All I can say is the new product in the picture on the right is not even close to the discontinued product. So just a heads up.
This did not come in a box and there was no protective shield that I had to remove. It’s as if someone returned it and it was resold. I am very uncomfortable giving this as a gift.
Neutogena is the brand my sister recommended and I am not disappointed. Works great for my dry skin.

Item arrived damaged and exploded out the wrong side. Clearly was cut by someone when packaged because it’s a clean slice through. What little product I was able to use seemed good and light weight. Didn’t aggravate my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Says fragrance free but has a faint scent
avis.texte: Review for Neutrogena Fragrance Free Daily Facial Moisturizer. This is a nice light-weight moisturizer. It blended and absorbed easily into my skin without leaving discoloration. I provided an image of my hand to show three blends: one with no blend straight out of the bottle, one slightly blended in, and one fully blended in. I had no irritations with this. However, I would say my skin is not too sensitive, so your mileage may vary. It says fragrance free but it did seem to have a slightly unpleasant smell if you smell it directly. After applying it on my face though, I didn't smell it so overall it's fine. Overall, it's a nice moisturizer.

avis.titre: Irritates, red raised bumps, red spots, eyes red & irritated
avis.texte: I had hopes it wouldn't irritate my skin. It burns my eyes and I only applied 1 inch away from eyes, completely avoiding eye socket too. Applied above eye brows and redness started right away. It is so itchy for my skin. I can feel a fake layer of whatever is in this stuff sit on top of my skin. I have to wash it off because my eyes are so irritated from this lotion. I'm disappointed in the ingredients in this lotion. After I get through about 30 minutes of wear it dries me out so bad that only washing it off does my skin recover. I will return. I've tried 4 to 5 times and it is horrible. You see pictures of my skin and eyes being irritated by this lotion. Will not buy another moisturizer from neutrogena until they fix ingredients.

I have super sensitive skin on my face and only a few product don't irritate my skin. Neutrogena is my go to most of the time and this new face cream feels great on. No irritation, feels light but hydrated, and a little goes a long way. It does have a light scent that I was worried would irritate my face but it did not.. Love it!
Amo esta marca, este producto humedece bastante y tiene ingredientes naturales me encanta
Love this neutrogena face cream. It is very light on my face and does not feel sticky. It moisturizes well and is good for any time of the day. I highly recommend this cream!

I really thought I would like this product for about the first 2 minutes. I liked the consistency, the way it went on smoothly and the fact it didn't take much to apply. After applying I went to wash my hands and noticed my face had started to get a burning sensation. It started with a slight burning at first but by the time I finished washing and drying my hands, my face felt like it was on fire. I've never had a product burn like this and I usually have normal skin so I would not recommend this for sensitive skin at all. I went straight to go wash it off and it felt like forever before I was able to get all the product off. Now even my gentle moisturizer burns when putting it on. This product damaged my skin in less than 5 minutes with only one use. I can't use any of the products I had been using for months in my skin care routine. Ultra gentle my @$$. I would not recommend this product
I'm not a fan of most of their products but this moisturizer is one of the better ones i've used. It is very hydrating but aftet an hour or so of wearing my skin got very oily.
This moisturizer leaving your face smooth and soft! Great quality and rich in moisture.

avis.titre: Eye irritant — do not buy — burns and hurts eyes
avis.texte: I hoped Neutrogena’s new Daily Facial Moisturizer would be a replacement for their old standby, Neutrogena’s Oil-free, fragrance-free, sensitive skin facial moisturizer, which they discontinued (see the photo with the purple bit on label). I am so sad. The new stuff is a toxic eye irritant— I only had it on briefly and my eyes cannot stop burning. Hurts a lot. Like getting nasty sunscreen in your eyes. Yes, the squeeze bottle is more convenient than the old pump, but I don’t wear the bottle on my face near my eyes. Neutrogena, **please** restore your old wonderful product, which I’d bought faithfully since the early 90s. Not the strongest moisturizer, but safe and non-irritating. Now please don’t mind me while I gauge out my burning eyes. Yeeooww this hurts. :-(
